burned_rc3_evidence.interpretation: The ordinary gravity/fluid safety policy overrode the registered hard topology route, while scheduled block physics caused additional non-importer transitions. The failure is retained and the gates are not relaxed.

single_allowed_correction.protected_route_policy: The exact one-block six-neighbor dilation of the canonical navigation raster is hash-pinned and has priority over ordinary gravity/fluid preservation. Non-route voxels retain the existing safety policy.
single_allowed_correction.capture_policy: Freeze scheduled ticks for the candidate evidence capture so the evaluator measures the deterministic importer output rather than post-import water or falling-block simulation.
single_allowed_correction.baseline_policy: Reuse the immutable already-generated same-seed baseline; verify its region hash before and after the candidate run.
single_allowed_correction.candidate_policy: Create one new disposable candidate by exact clone of the baseline. Do not mutate or replace the burned rc3 world.
